init_logger_with_file: initialize a logger with stdout, stderr, and optional file output for distributed jobs
init_logger_with_name_and_level: initialize a named logger at a specific log level with custom formatting
use_LogFormatter_for_distributed_logging: use the LogFormatter class to format log records with rank, timestamp, and elapsed time
set_root_log_level: set the root logger level to a string name or integer value
format_multiline_log_messages: format multiline log messages and exceptions with proper indentation matching the log prefix
